description: The element and label steps of the SSN pilot (D67, D72): the steps a label recipe runs after its carrier rows (dw_generated_rows per carrier run, 017 17.4). They make each carrier's element follow the plan's kind AND form: one synth_identifier step per (perturbation, delimiter style) with its own output_prefix (20 steps: 5 kinds x 4 styles; the wrong_length steps use synth_identifier@1.1.0 with wrong_length_layout 'style', the others @1), then one rule_label step that copies, per row, the column matching the row's kind and form into 'element' (decoy kinds get null: insert_element@1 takes their value from the rule set's decoy lists). Forms that are renderings take an undelimited value (spaced, spelled, split_lines, mixed_words recover only that) and prose a dashed one (elements.json style_by_form). Then insert_element@1, drop_columns (the e_* working columns), rule_set@1 and derive_labels@1 (labels.json). Proved through a real local build by backend/tests/integration/behaviour/test_ssn_pilot_elements.py. One declared gap: the rule set's mixed_words rendering leaves a value with no odd digit unchanged (elements.json known_gaps, Q8).
pin_note: D72: rule_set.json is saved as a NEW version of dlp-ssn-us-elements at 17.3 (dataworks_save_rule_set). rule_set_sha256 is the digest of this pack's rule_set.json (rules.rule_set.digest, RFC 8785 canonical bytes) and must equal the sha256 the save returns; rule_set_version is null until then and is filled in every pinned step here and in templates.json's check_rule_sets with the version the save returns. A null version fails recipe validation, so an unfilled pin cannot build. The 016 document stored before it has sha256 0d975ea4c12102092307a30d311597c50503adff528a116007eebd493f558183.
